name: superhero
definition: 具有超常能力或特殊身份、由出版机构创作并归属于特定阵营的虚构人物 Counterexample: 普通人类角色：不具备超常能力或特殊身份，不属于超级英雄类别；超级英雄需同时具备虚构人物身份与超常/特殊属性 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superhero; provenance: direct source superhero

name: gender
definition: 用于对人物按生理或社会身份进行划分的分类项 Counterexample: 种族：按血统或物种来源划分，与性别按生理/社会身份划分的维度不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gender; provenance: direct source gender

name: alignment
definition: 用于标识虚构人物在道德或立场上所属派别的分类项 Counterexample: 出版商：标识作品版权归属机构，与阵营标识人物道德立场不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table alignment; provenance: direct source alignment

name: attribute
definition: 用于描述人物特征或能力的可度量或可分类的维度项 Counterexample: 超能力：具体的能力名称，与属性作为可度量维度的抽象分类不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attribute; provenance: direct source attribute

name: colour
definition: 用于描述人物外观特征（如眼睛、头发、皮肤）的色彩分类项 Counterexample: 属性：描述能力或特征的维度，与颜色作为外观色彩分类不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table colour; provenance: direct source colour

name: race
definition: 用于对人物按血统或物种来源进行划分的分类项 Counterexample: 性别：按生理或社会身份划分，与种族按血统或物种来源划分不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table race; provenance: direct source race

name: publisher
definition: 负责创作、出版和发行虚构人物作品的机构 Counterexample: 阵营：标识人物道德立场，与出版商作为作品版权归属机构不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table publisher; provenance: direct source publisher

name: superpower
definition: 虚构人物所拥有的超出自然人类极限的特殊能力 Counterexample: 属性：描述人物特征的可度量维度，与超能力作为具体特殊能力不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table superpower; provenance: direct source superpower

name: hero_attribute
definition: 记录某虚构人物在某一属性维度上取值的关联记录 Counterexample: 英雄超能力关联：记录人物与超能力的对应，与属性关联记录人物在属性维度上的取值不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_attribute; provenance: direct source hero_attribute

name: hero_power
definition: 记录某虚构人物拥有某一超能力的关联记录 Counterexample: 英雄属性关联：记录人物在属性维度上的取值，与超能力关联记录人物拥有的具体能力不同 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table hero_power; provenance: direct source hero_power

name: FemaleGender
definition: 性别为女性的超级英雄

name: MaleGender
definition: 性别为男性的超级英雄

name: MarvelPublisher
definition: 出版方为 Marvel Comics 的超级英雄

name: DCPublisher
definition: 出版方为 DC Comics 的超级英雄

name: DarkHorsePublisher
definition: 出版方为 Dark Horse Comics 的超级英雄

name: SuperStrengthPower
definition: 拥有 Super Strength 超能力的超级英雄

name: BadAlignment
definition: 阵营为反派(Bad)的超级英雄

name: GreenSkin
definition: 皮肤颜色为绿色的超级英雄

name: NoEyeColour
definition: 眼睛颜色为 No Colour 的超级英雄

name: HeightCm
definition: 超级英雄的身高(厘米)

name: WeightKg
definition: 超级英雄的体重(千克)

name: SuperheroName
definition: 超级英雄的代号名称

name: FullName
definition: 超级英雄的真实姓名

name: HeroId
definition: 超级英雄的唯一标识 ID

name: MaleToFemaleRatio
definition: 男性超级英雄数量与女性超级英雄数量的比值 Formula: COUNT(MaleGender) / COUNT(FemaleGender). Inputs: MaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Male'; FemaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Female'
aliases: ratio between male and female superheroes

name: PublisherHeroCountDifference
definition: 两个出版方所出版的超级英雄数量之差 Formula: COUNT(DCPublisher) - COUNT(MarvelPublisher). Inputs: DCPublisher = publisher.publisher_name WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'; MarvelPublisher = publisher.publisher_name WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
aliases: difference in number of superheroes published

name: WeightDifference
definition: 两个超级英雄体重之差 Formula: SUM(WeightKg WHERE FullName='Emil Blonsky') - SUM(WeightKg WHERE FullName='Charles Chandler'). Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg; FullName = superhero.full_name

name: AverageFemaleWeight
definition: 所有女性超级英雄的平均体重 Formula: AVG(WeightKg) WHERE FemaleGender. Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg; FemaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Female'

name: AverageWeight
definition: 所有超级英雄的平均体重 Formula: AVG(WeightKg). Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg

name: WeightAbove79PctAvg
definition: 体重超过全体平均体重 79% 的男性超级英雄 Formula: WeightKg > 0.79 * AVG(WeightKg). Inputs: WeightKg = superhero.weight_kg; MaleGender = gender.gender WHERE gender = 'Male'

name: SuperStrengthTallCount
definition: 拥有 Super Strength 且身高超过 200cm 的超级英雄数量 Formula: COUNT(SuperStrengthPower WHERE HeightCm > 200). Inputs: SuperStrengthPower = superpower.power_name WHERE power_name = 'Super Strength'; HeightCm = superhero.height_cm

name: GreenVillainCount
definition: 皮肤为绿色且阵营为反派的超级英雄数量 Formula: COUNT(GreenSkin WHERE BadAlignment). Inputs: GreenSkin = colour.colour WHERE colour = 'Green'; BadAlignment = alignment.alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad'

name: NoEyeColourCount
definition: 身高在 170 到 190 之间且没有眼睛颜色的超级英雄数量 Formula: COUNT(NoEyeColour WHERE HeightCm BETWEEN 170 AND 190). Inputs: NoEyeColour = colour.colour WHERE colour = 'No Colour'; HeightCm = superhero.height_cm

name: Gender
definition: 按性别划分超级英雄,用于统计男女数量、比例及分组分析

name: Alignment
definition: 按阵营划分超级英雄,用于统计英雄、反派及中立角色数量

name: Publisher
definition: 按出版方划分超级英雄,用于比较不同漫画公司出版的角色数量与属性

name: Attribute
definition: 按属性类型划分英雄能力,用于查询力量、耐久、速度等具体数值

name: Colour
definition: 按颜色划分英雄外观,用于查询眼睛、头发、皮肤颜色

name: Superpower
definition: 按超能力类型划分英雄,用于查询拥有特定能力的英雄

name: Race
definition: 按种族划分超级英雄,用于查询特定种族的角色
